title: Hook hangs past timeout on secret file
reason_not_testable: Needs a hook that exceeds its deadline. The spec defines only SECRET_HOOK_HOME and SECRET_HOOK_ROOTS and no delay injection, and e2e cannot force one. PostToolUse timeout behaviour is UNVERIFIED in the catalog. Non-hook control: set the settings timeout above the hook's internal deadline and check the deadline branch with a manual slow-harvest run.
